entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. Can I have your name and order number, please?
Hi Alex, my name is Sarah Mills. The order number is VF88312. I'm calling because... I'm just so disappointed. I need to return my order.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed, Sarah. I've pulled up your order for the cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?

They just don't work for me. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats over and over, but every time I ride I get the most painful blisters. It's just awful. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I've never had this happen.
Getting blisters from new shoes is definitely frustrating, and I'm sorry that's been your experience. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I just... I really needed this money back for the holidays. I was counting on it.

I understand completely. Alright, I've checked here and it looks like you received them 58 days ago. Our policy for standard items like these cycling shoes is a 90-day return window, so you're well within the timeframe. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried.

Of course, Sarah. I'm happy to help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll process your refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
